scope: Documentation Portal UI/UX Polish, Responsive Viewport Optimization, Internal Scroll Snapping, and Global Omnisearch

tasks.title: Nested Content Scroll Isolation with Snapping Slide Transitions
tasks.description: Fix wheel/touch event propagation within the PowerPoint documentation slide container. When the active slide content overflows vertically, wheel and touch gestures must scroll internal card content smoothly without advancing the deck. Only when the scroll position hits the boundary (scrollTop === 0 on upward scroll, or scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight - 2 on downward scroll) should the GSAP slide-change animation advance or revert the active slide.

tasks.title: Fix Left Slide Thumbnail Strip Boundary & Header Collision
tasks.description: Resolve the visual glitch where scrolling slide thumbnails upward causes the first slide thumbnail card to slip underneath or collide with the fixed sidebar header and filter input. Apply strict boundary positioning (`sticky top-0 z-10` with matching backdrop surface fill or `overflow-y-auto` with explicit top padding/margins) on the thumbnail list container so cards stay cleanly contained.

tasks.title: Implement Horizontal Folder-Style ScrollTrigger Section Flow on Home Page
tasks.description: Restructure the Home page landing sections ('/' route) into a horizontal folder deck flow. Pin the section container using GSAP ScrollTrigger and translate sections horizontally (`xPercent: -100 * (sections.length - 1)`). On mobile touch viewports, allow vertical touch drag within cards, advancing horizontally only when the user swipes or scrolls to the terminal boundary of the active folder section.

tasks.title: Responsive Layout Refactor for Mobile & Tablet Viewports
tasks.description: Audit and adapt the desktop PowerPoint frame for tablet (< 1024px) and mobile (< 768px) screens. Eliminate desktop clipping, horizontal overflow, and fixed 1440px width constraints. Re-architect the application shell into fluid percentage/flex layouts, adjust font scale clamps, ensure code blocks scroll horizontally with touch-friendly paddings, and adjust the PowerPoint title and ribbon bars for small-screen ergonomics.

tasks.title: Bottom Horizontal Slide Filmstrip for Mobile and Tablet Viewports
tasks.description: Implement responsive breakpoint switching for the slide deck navigation: hide the vertical 280px left thumbnail sidebar on screens narrower than 1024px, and render an anchored bottom horizontal slide filmstrip (`h-20` to `h-24`, horizontal scroll snap, 16:9 mini thumbnail cards). Ensure selecting or auto-advancing slides centers the active card horizontally in the filmstrip.

tasks.title: Global Omnisearch Modal with Deep-Link Navigation
tasks.description: Upgrade the top header search bar into a universal omnisearch dialog (triggered via click or `Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`). Build a fast in-memory search index aggregating all routes, sections, guide headings, and API functions from `docs-site/src/data/*.json`. Display categorized results with keyboard arrow navigation and redirect directly to the matched route and specific slide/section anchor.
